facts.note: the failed stability test; the king at war pushing her to sea; two decks of bronze guns high up; the sinking in the harbour (gusts, open lower ports); the hearing blames no one ('Only God knows'); too little ballast, and more would sink the ports

jokes.note: 'Nobody wants to tell the king his masterpiece wobbles'; 'the crowd keeps waving'; 'one builder's best explanation is, Only God knows' / 'The man who ordered the cannons was the king'

reversal.note: the safe launch becomes a sinking in front of the city; the last line turns the opening test into the warning

ridicule.note: no one mocks the test: the doubter (the admiral) is overruled, not laughed at. S6 is low confidence and we don't invent jeers for real people

mechanism_visible.note: bottle with sand, heavy bronze high, stone low, ports at the waterline

shootable_share.note: every sentence names a thing: sailors, admiral, king, cannons, letters, crowd, gusts, ports, hearing, bottle, stone

hook_act_on_screen.note: thirty sailors running across the deck = frame 0
